brief: public Reader parse(File file, Metadata metadata) throws IOException{}
method_comment:
* Parses the given file and returns the extracted text content. *

* Metadata information extracted from the document is returned in * the supplied metadata instance. * * @param file the file to be parsed * @param metadata where document's metadata will be populated * @return extracted text content * @throws IOException if the file can not be read or parsed * @see #parse(Path)
